The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched an '''assault''' against the [[Cardooine/Legends|Cardooine]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel base (Cardooine)|base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Zal" /> The strike force was stymied when the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Tendaar Bel]] scrambled the Imperial IFF codes,<ref name="Tendaar" /> allowing the [[Soaring Dactillions]], flying prototype [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], to route the force. All but two of the Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were killed in the assault, although the base was spared. The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] proved that the A-wing featured superb qualities.<ref name="Zal" /> Soon after, Bel<ref name="Tendaar" /> and pilot [[Zal Artha]] were assigned to [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]].<ref name="Zal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The base was mentioned in Zal Artha and Tendaar Bel's Character Folios included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.<ref name="Zal" /><ref name="Tendaar" />
